## Où j'en suis
Sam asked for AE owner + ARR from HubSpot on the admin accounts page. The webhook approach (#405) was abandoned because private app tokens can't manage webhook subscriptions; it was replaced by a 15-min polling job (CRM search, windowed paging past the 10k cap, only companies with ARR > 0), committed in `8b3e6f1`, `2d90ac4`, `ae47c15`. PR #409 is still open with auto-merge set, blocked by a failing e2e check; the agent's claim that it merged was wrong.

- [en-cours] Fix e2e `test_admin_accounts.py::test_accounts_table_shows_owner` (expected 3 rows with owner, got 2): fixture has a trial company now skipped by the `arr > 0` filter.
- [prochaine-étape] Update the fixture (give the third company ARR > 0, or expect 2 rows), push, let auto-merge fire on #409.
- [prochaine-étape] Noa adds `HUBSPOT_TOKEN` to AWS Secrets Manager for staging/prod.
- [essai-raté] Webhook subscription registration via API returned 401: needs a developer API key / public app, so polling was chosen instead (tour t03).
- [décision] Use polling every 15 min instead of webhooks; close #405 (source: t04).
- [décision] Sync only companies with ARR > 0, skip trials entirely (source: t10).
